precedence: This override is higher authority only for the Admin Portal Login Details lookup and deliberate credential-reset action. All non-conflicting Portal V2, Admin batch creation, Replace Resource and shared-Worker authority remains binding.

requiredBehaviour.lookupSecretBoundary: The read-only lookup confirms whether stored Login and Answer Pack credentials exist but does not return their existing values.
requiredBehaviour.resetBehaviour: After the operator explicitly chooses Reset & Show New Credentials, generate a new four-character Login password and a different four-character Answer Pack password using the existing Portal password generator, replace only p/loginPassword/answerPassword in the existing student record, verify the write, and return the newly generated values in that response so the Admin console can display them.
requiredBehaviour.notFoundRule: Unknown Portal IDs return STUDENT_NOT_FOUND without creating an account.

preservationInvariants: Lookup does not write, delete or rewrite STUDENTS_KV.
Credential reset does not change student batch assignments.
Credential reset does not change lesson entitlements, prepared access, Trial consumption, sessions or account state.
Credential reset does not change portalUserId, name, school year, VR eligibility or other student profile fields.
Credential reset must preserve the existing student record by spreading the current record and replacing only the credential fields.
If verification of the credential write fails, attempt to restore the original student record and return CREDENTIAL_RESET_FAILED.
Trial and Admin IDs must use their dedicated account controls rather than this normal-student reset path.
